Bundled Sandboxie-Plus portable payload
=====================================

Sandboxie-Plus 1.18.8 x64 is extracted in its official portable mode
and included under bundled\Sandboxie-Plus. The vendor's original
binaries are redistributed unmodified and free of charge. The build
checks the source download and the runtime fingerprints before packaging.
SANDBOXIE-SHA256SUMS.txt records the staged files. Sandboxie-Plus may
update the local configuration files during use.

Start Sandboxie Manager from a local copy of the portable folder in a
location that standard users cannot modify, such as a directory an
administrator prepared under Program Files. Windows requires
administrator approval to start its service and driver. Keep
Sandboxie Manager running while you capture. When done, exit it
and choose the option to stop and remove the temporary services. A compatible running installation can be used
directly. Avoid starting a second copy alongside it.

Source download:
https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/releases/download/v1.18.8/Sandboxie-Plus-x64-v1.18.8.exe
24,930,680 bytes
SHA-256 f27078ff74a07906fd51476079e1a7a8f5e20c8bb75a9d2ae86169d47179ae76

Exact source and upstream notices:
https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/tree/v1.18.8
